items.title: Q1 Earnings Scorecard: Strong demand drives revenue, input costs hit profits
items.description: Sustained market demand led to impressive revenue growth in the automotive and consumer goods sectors. In contrast, while the banking sector showed better asset quality, profitability struggled due to margin challenges. Cement companies effectively preserved their margins through strategic cost management amidst rising operational costs. Overall, various sectors experienced notable revenue uplifts; however, they also faced persistent input cost hurdles.

items.title: Titan gains 3% as strong Q1 results lift Street sentiment
items.description: Titan shares surged, topping Nifty gains after stellar June-quarter earnings surpassed expectations. This positive performance has prompted multiple brokerages to revise their price targets upwards, signaling strong investor confidence. With a predominantly bullish outlook from analysts, Titan's stock appears poised for further appreciation.

items.title: MRF Q1 Results: PAT dips 6% YoY to Rs 479 crore; shares fall 3% amid sharp margin contraction
items.description: MRF reported a 6.5% YoY decline in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 479 crore, despite a 10% rise in revenue to Rs 8,416 crore. EBITDA fell 7.5%, while margins contracted to 11.77% from 13.95%. Higher material costs weighed on profitability. Shares fell 3% following the results. The company also announced two senior management appointments.

items.title: KPI Green Energy Q1 Results: Net profit dips 14% at Rs 95 crore
items.description: KPI Green Energy experienced a fourteen percent dip in net profit for the June quarter, signaling the effects of geopolitical tensions and rising costs on financing and depreciation. Despite this, the company reported a notable sixteen percent increase in total revenue, amounting to Rs 710 crore. Additionally, Kapil Kriplani has been appointed as the new Chief Financial Officer, following Salim Yahoo's resignation from the role.

items.title: Zydus Lifesciences Q1 Results: Net profit down 36% at Rs 939.8 crore
items.description: Zydus Lifesciences reported a significant year-on-year decline of thirty-six percent in net profit for the first quarter, despite a robust twenty-two percent increase in operational revenue, reaching eight thousand seventeen crore rupees. The company experienced profitability challenges with an EBITDA reduction of seven point six percent compared to the previous year. Following the announcement, their stock price saw an uptick. Zydus is a prominent player in the global pharmaceutical landscape.

items.title: Siemens Q1 Results: Net profit declines 18% to Rs 343 crore
items.description: Siemens Ltd reported a decline in net profit of over eighteen percent in the June quarter, largely due to fluctuating commodity prices and rising material costs. On a positive note, the company experienced a significant increase in operational revenue, underlining strong demand. Additionally, new orders surged, particularly within the Smart Infrastructure segment, driven by robust investments from both private and public sectors.

items.title: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Q1 profit rises on strong business wins, freight volumes
items.description: TVS Supply Chain Solutions reported a 28.7% rise in Q1FY27 revenue and 34% growth in adjusted EBITDA, supported by strong volumes and global forwarding. Record quarterly business wins reached ₹543 crore, while adjusted PBT surged 71%.

items.title: RVNL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 18% YoY, EBITDA more than doubles
items.description: Rail Vikas Nigam reported an 18.5% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹159.36 crore, while revenue increased 10.6%. EBITDA more than doubled, lifting margins, though profit and revenue declined sequentially amid continued pressure on the stock.
